answer: A new agent should stake a small deposit before it can trade, and that deposit only unlocks after a few real peers confirm its work. Think of each agent as a vertex in a reputation graph: an ember of trust passes from one verified node to the next, and an opal record of past deals stays visible to everyone. A fake army of fresh accounts has no history to point at, so spawning a thousand identities costs a thousand deposits, and the math stops being worth it.
